content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents a patient with \"recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks,\" consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9. Per the ordering documentation, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered \"to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.\" Because authorization was missing rather than the service being unsupported, we request review of this clinical documentation and reprocessing of the $562.08 balance."}
